scenes.script_line: [B1] Hello. I'm Pedro. If you're watching this, you're part of Craveiral.
scenes.visual_direction: Warm opening: a team member walks onto a rustic farm property at first light, greeted with a smile — the feeling of joining something. Medium shot, golden light.

shots.text: team member walking onto a farm property at first light, greeted with a smile
shots.pexels: person arriving at farm greeted morning

shots.text: wide shot of a whitewashed farmhouse at sunrise
close-up of a handshake at a farm gate

scenes.script_line: [B2] Twenty years ago I was a lawyer in Lisbon — and I kept dreaming about land, about getting my hands in the soil.
scenes.visual_direction: Contrast beat: Lisbon city rooftops / a man gazing from an office window, then cut-away to hands sinking into dark soil. City-to-land longing.

shots.text: Lisbon rooftops seen from a window
man in a suit looking out of an office window, thoughtful
shots.pexels: man looking out office window thoughtful

shots.text: hands sinking into dark soil
shots.pexels: hands in dark soil close up

scenes.script_line: [B3] I found a field of carnations — cravos. A field of carnations is a 'craveiral'. That's where the name comes from.
scenes.visual_direction: The origin image: a wild field of carnations in bloom, close detail of the flowers swaying, honest and unstyled. Detail shot. [image-beat]

shots.text: wild field of carnations in bloom
close detail of red carnations swaying
hand touching a carnation stem in a field

scenes.script_line: [B4] Nine hectares of wild Alentejo, minutes from the most beautiful unspoiled coastline in Europe. Skies so clear guests stop to point at the stars.
scenes.visual_direction: Sweeping wide: raw Alentejo landscape rolling to dramatic Atlantic cliffs, then a starry night sky over dark countryside. Epic but natural. [image-beat]

shots.text: raw Alentejo landscape rolling to Atlantic cliffs
starry night sky over dark countryside
person pointing at the stars, silhouette

scenes.script_line: [B5] That was 2010. We opened in 2018. Eight years between the dream and the first guest.
scenes.visual_direction: Perseverance: timber-frame construction in a rural setting, craftsman hands at work, architectural plans on a worn table. Medium and detail shots.

shots.text: timber-frame construction in a rural setting, carpenter at work
craftsman's hands fitting a wooden joint
architectural plans on a worn wooden table

scenes.script_line: [B6] Craveiral was not built to be a hotel. It was built to be a relationship with a piece of land. Land first, hotel second.
scenes.visual_direction: Tactile reverence: weathered hands cupping rich dark earth, a farmer crouched examining soil, low sun flaring through. Intimate detail. [image-beat]

scenes.script_line: [B7] We have nine hectares. Only four percent is constructed. The emptiness, the space, the silence at night — that IS the product.
scenes.visual_direction: Wide aerial over a green estate: a few low buildings dissolved in orchards, gardens and pine forest — vast open space around tiny footprint.

scenes.script_line: [B8] Thirty-eight houses connected by raised wooden walkways — raised wood lets the land breathe underneath.
scenes.visual_direction: Ground-level tracking along a raised wooden boardwalk winding through greenery toward whitewashed minimalist houses; plants growing beneath the slats.

shots.text: tracking along a raised wooden boardwalk through greenery toward white houses
plants growing under wooden slats, close

scenes.script_line: [B9] We do not own the land — we belong to it, for a while. Our job is to leave it better than we found it.
scenes.visual_direction: The heart of the module: a lone figure walking slowly through an olive grove or cork oak field at golden hour, unhurried, at home in the land. Wide. [image-beat]

scenes.script_line: [B10] I've watched a child collect eggs and run to show her parents like treasure. So yes — every single day, it's worth it.
scenes.visual_direction: Payoff: a child gathering fresh eggs on a farm, running with joy; a couple beneath pines; village workers smiling. Warm human close. [image-beat]
